notes.title: Controls for combat
notes.notes:
Controls (Playstation 4 Controller)
X - Jump
Square - Light Attack (hold control stick towards enemy when pressing square to do alt. light combo for mix ups)
Triangle - Heavy attack (hold control stick towards enemy when pressing triangle to do alt. heavy combo for mix ups)
Circle - Dash
R1 - Block
R1 + Up + Y - Unique character attack (there is a 5 second cool down to these attacks)
R1 + Down + Y - Launch attack for air combat
L1 - Breaker (uses 2 meter bars)
L2 + R2 - Special attack (when all bars on meter are full)

Controls (Xbox One Controller)
A - Jump
X - Light Attack
Y - Heavy attack
B - Dash
RB - Block
RB + Up + Y - Unique character attack (range attack)
RB + Down + Y - Launch attack for air combat
LB - Breaker
LT + RT - Special attack
